name: slack/bot
title: Slack — a bot in a workspace

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: The bot's own token. Acts as the app, not as a person.

SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET.description: Proves a request came from Slack. Without it anyone can post to your endpoint.

SLACK_APP_TOKEN.description: App-level token, needed for Socket Mode.

SLACK_USER_TOKEN.description: Acts as the installing person. Prefer the bot token where either works.
